text: 周二（9月15日）纽约尾盘，美国10年期基准国债收益率涨1.03个基点，报4.9978%，整体冲高回落，北京时间15:52曾达到5.0390%，逼近2007年7月9日盘中最高位5.1952%、当年6月13日顶部5.3228%，9月4日（美国劳动节长周末前）结束交易以来这一波涨幅已经超过21个基点。 两年期美债收益率涨0.49个基点，报4.6628%，日内交投于4.6351%-4.6861%区间。 20年期美债收益率涨1.71个基点，报5.4021%，15:52曾达到5.4418%，彭博数据显示这是2020年以来最高位；30年期美债收益率涨1.84个基点，
text_en: In late New York trading on Tuesday (September 15), the yield on the benchmark 10-year U.S. Treasury note rose 1.03 basis points to 4.9978%, retreating after an intraday spike. At 15:52 Beijing time, it reached 5.0390%, approaching the intraday high of 5.1952% on July 9, 2007 and the peak of 5.3228% on June 13 of that year. Since trading ended on September 4 (before the U.S. Labor Day long weekend), this wave of gains has exceeded 21 basis points. The two-year U.S. Treasury yield rose 0.49 basis points to 4.6628%, trading within a range of 4.6351%-4.6861% during the day. The 20-year U.S. Treasury yield rose 1.71 basis points to 5.4021%, having reached 5.4418% at 15:52, the highest level since 2020 according to Bloomberg data.
